ns2:section.sectionText: Prerequisites will be enforced. This course will open to all Gies Business Administration majors on Monday, November 15, 2021 and to all other Gies majors and Informatics Minors on Monday, November 22, 2021 at approximately 10:00 a.m. There are currently 10 reserved seats for Gies College of Business international exchange students; any unused seats will be released to students meeting the restrictions on Friday, January 21, 2022 at approximately 10:00 a.m. Any exchange students outside of Gies College of Business that register will be removed from the course.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Marketing or Information Sys & Info Tech or Supply Chain Management or Business Process Management or Management or Informatics or Accountancy or Finance or Information Systems or STR BUS DEV & Entrepreneurship or Operations Management major(s) or minor(s).
